description:
About the company
 Our client is a software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take ownership of a brand-new product and the infrastructure behind it, building AI-powered systems that run reliably in production. Partner directly with customers and help set engineering standards, team culture and the technical direction.
 What you'll do
 - Design an AI agent layer with built-in review and validation steps before outputs reach people or other systems.
 - Build secure connectors and a runtime that can interpret complex enterprise software environments.
 - Create developer-facing tooling and a code analysis capability for modernizing older codebases.
 - Set up low-latency model serving with detailed monitoring of usage and performance.
 - Take language-model pipelines, information retrieval and light model tuning from prototype to production where they add clear value.
 - Collaborate directly with customers on high-impact projects.
 - Help shape the engineering bar, team culture and product roadmap.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Experience working on enterprise or B2B AI products.
 - Foundational machine learning experience, whether from research, school internships or full-time work.
 - A track record of shipping production code in a shared team codebase.
 - Experience with large language models and AI platforms, including building agent frameworks and evaluating models or agents.
 - Hands-on experience coordinating multi-step AI agent systems and retrieval-based approaches.
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science or machine learning from a top-tier university.
 - Regular use of AI tools in daily work, with practical views on how they can improve engineering and operations.
 - Strong ownership, clear communication and comfort deciding with incomplete information.
 - Ability to move quickly and carefully, and willingness to pick up new technologies.
 Bonus points
 - Software engineering experience at high-growth technology companies or startups.
 - Published machine learning research.
 - Familiarity with an agent orchestration framework.
 - 2 to 4 years of experience is the ideal range.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 175,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, CA, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in office
 - Full-time
